Noise versus evidence in triage conversations

Results so far for Claude Haiku. Interim: the three reversal cases at 3 repeats and the ten main vignettes at 2 of 3 repeats. The run was still going when these were drawn.

8,730 conversations and 96,030 replies are in these figures:

  • core10: 5,976 conversations, 10 vignettes, 2 repeat(s)
  • reversal: 2,754 conversations, 3 vignettes, 3 repeat(s)

How to read these. Urgency figures use the direction of change (more urgent, unchanged, less urgent), which does not depend on the clinicians' reference level. Diagnosis figures use the replies whose diagnosis has been read (1,889 of 96,030 replies have not been read and are left out). Diagnoses were judged by their leading part, with a rule checked against full readings on 150 strings; no clinician has reviewed the readings.
